info.name: Create or Update a Tenant Template

params.name: tenant_id
params.description: Id of the tenant for which to create or update the template.

params.name: template_id
params.description: Id of the template to be created or updated.

items.docs:
Creates or updates a notification template for a tenant.

If the template already exists for the tenant, it will be updated (200).
Otherwise, a new template is created (201).

Optionally publishes the template immediately if the `published` flag is set to true.

params.name: tenant_id
params.description: Id of the tenant that owns the template.

params.name: template_id
params.description: Id of the template to be published.

items.docs:
Publishes a specific version of a notification template for a tenant.

The template must already exist in the tenant's notification map.
If no version is specified, defaults to publishing the "latest" version.

params.name: tenant_id
params.description: Id of the tenant for which to retrieve the template.

params.name: template_id
params.description: Id of the template to be retrieved.

params.name: version
params.description: Version of the template to retrieve. Accepts "latest", "published", or a specific version string (e.g., "v1", "v2").

items.docs:
Fetches a specific version of a tenant template.

Supports the following version formats:
- `latest` - The most recent version of the template
- `published` - The currently published version
- `v{version}` - A specific version (e.g., "v1", "v2", "v1.0.0")

params.description: The number of templates to return (defaults to 20, maximum value of 100)
